description: The FR-008 built-in tools (plus M1-TL-07 search_documents) as the model sees them. Shared by the P0-05/P0-06/P0-07 suites. Names are snake_case, verb-first, because the model reads them as prompt text. Argument schemas use only what a Foundation Models GenerationSchema can express: string/number/integer, enum, regex pattern, description, required.
dateTimeFormat: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, local wall-clock time in the suite's reference time zone, no offset

tools.name: calculate
tools.description: Evaluate an arithmetic expression and return the numeric result. Use for any math: percentages, splitting amounts, unit rates.

expression.description: An arithmetic expression using numbers, + - * / and parentheses, e.g. "0.175 * 2480".

tools.name: list_calendar_events
tools.description: List the user's calendar events that overlap a time range.

tools.name: create_reminder
tools.description: Create a reminder for the user, optionally with a due date and time. The user will be asked to confirm.

due.description: When the reminder is due, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM. Omit if the user gave no time.

tools.name: search_contacts
tools.description: Search the user's contacts by name, company, or role and return matching contact cards.

query.description: Name, company, or role to search for.

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Find files on the device by file name and metadata. Returns file names and locations, not their contents.

query.description: Words likely to appear in the file name or metadata.

file_type.description: Restrict results to one kind of file.

tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Search inside the contents of the user's indexed documents and return the most relevant passages. Use to answer questions about what a document says.

query.description: What to look for in the document contents.

tools.name: create_note
tools.description: Save a new note. The user will be asked to confirm.

body.description: The full text of the note.

tools.name: search_notes
tools.description: Search the user's saved notes and return matching notes.

query.description: Words to search for in the notes.
